summary: Created Sales Order SAL-ORD-2026-00004 for customer "fwen4-luna-n1 Bench Customer" with delivery date 2026-12-31, saved as a draft. The customer was chosen from the link-field's suggestion list (the exact option "fwen4-luna-n1 Bench Customer", not free text), and the delivery date was typed into the header Delivery Date field. On save the app navigated to the record page and showed the green "Saved" confirmation with status Draft; reading the saved form back confirms Customer = "fwen4-luna-n1 Bench Customer" and Delivery Date = 2026-12-31. Note: the app refused to save with an empty Items table ("Please fill the following mandatory fields before saving: Items is required"), so one item row (Bench Gadget, from the suggestions offered for this customer) had to be added for the draft to save.
